summary.headline: Nautical Winds and Sailing Omens
summary.text: A nautical weather treatise describes pachnites weather, the Soreutes star, seasonal storms, rhektes winds, sea disturbances, wave-reading, and sailing routes from Syria and Egypt toward Romania, Antioch, and Tarsus. It also records sailors’ observance of particular weekdays and holy days, including the Sabbath, the fifth day associated with Judas’s betrayal, and Good Friday.
